format.notes: Printer-specific template overrides working safe-area defaults. Prefer extra room near gutter-facing critical copy.

INK.role: primary body text and structural rules

MUTED_INK.role: secondary text on stable light fields only

PINK_STRONG.role: emotional accent / strong label / title support

DEEP_TEAL.role: dark green field for reversed type

WHITE.role: reversed type on sufficiently dark field

contrastPolicy.note: WCAG-style ratio is used as a conservative internal screen/preflight heuristic, not as a substitute for physical print proof.

colorRules: Body copy defaults to INK on PAPER or WARM_CREAM.
WHITE text is pre-approved only on PINK_STRONG, COBALT, or DEEP_TEAL unless a new pair is measured.
Use INK text on CORAL, SUNNY_YELLOW, LAGOON_CYAN, and MINT.
Do not encode information by hue alone; pair color with explicit text/shape/position.
Do not put long body copy directly over busy photography.
Each page uses one dominant, one support, and one surprise accent rather than all colors equally.

rules: Japanese is the primary editorial voice.
Display and body typography must have different jobs.
Avoid narrow text boxes that break Japanese into awkward fragments.
Critical information must never be relegated to microtype.
Actual font metrics and physical-size QA override nominal point ranges.

semanticPrefixes.REAL_PHOTO_: real-photo candidate; verify subject/role/pixels before final
semanticPrefixes.GENERATED_: generated candidate requiring visual and print QA
semanticPrefixes.PHOTO_CUTOUT_: support/cutout imagery; spill must be intentional
semanticPrefixes.FRAME_: frame artwork; keep photo separate and replaceable
semanticPrefixes.REFERENCE_: quality/composition reference only; never production placement
semanticPrefixes.LOWRES_: not production-ready until replaced or proven adequate
